releaseNotes: Closing the desktop app now protects every open project when a save fails, is cancelled or becomes outdated.
Native macOS Undo and Redo correctly restore artwork command batches and Lua transactions. Fixed a shutdown error and false file-conflict warnings after metadata-only changes.
Improved indexed colors, frame palettes, linked cels and tile rendering. Added palette generation, color matching and dithering options.
Added color-profile assignment and conversion, managed previews, and color-aware rendered exports.
Added Lua scripting with transactions, dialogs, image and color operations, image specifications, cel ordering and tileset editing.
Extension packages can run explicit commands with saved preferences; script edits remain undoable.
Improved pixel rotation, fractional export scaling and animation directions and repeat counts.
Expanded CLI exports with input-scoped selections, grid extraction, finite tag playback and ordered scale/crop operations.
Updated scripting, color and file-compatibility documentation. Existing projects and Pro ownership licenses remain on your device.
